parent_objective: design a bounded consolidation of overlapping localization slices into actionable target and guardrail categories
blocked_by: M2365 produced overlapping diagnostic slices that cannot be used directly as repair inputs
M2366 requires a consolidation design before materializing repair targets
supersedes: direct repair from all 313 localization rows
profile or pack ranking from localization rows

public_gates: M2367 must define canonical actionable target axes and diagnostic-only axes
M2367 must preserve collision guardrail and R4 mitigation semantics boundaries
M2367 must select a bounded artifact-only materialization route or stop the branch
forbidden_shortcuts: do not rank support policies or controller families
do not overwrite the active scenario config
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns audited localization output into a design for non-overlapping actionable target and guardrail artifacts
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no rerun, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, or training-repair claim
stop_condition: stop if actionable axes cannot be separated from diagnostic profile/pack/global axes
stop if R4 mitigation semantics would be mixed into ordinary offtrack repair
stop if collision guardrails cannot be preserved
stop if design routes directly to training or ranking
fallback_plan: route to branch synthesis if localization cannot be consolidated
route to schema repair if necessary fields are missing
route to artifact-only materializer if consolidation design is bounded
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2366 accepts M2365 localization and requires consolidation before repair

allowed_updates: M2367 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the design
next_stage_criteria: canonical actionable and diagnostic axes are specified
R4 and collision guardrail boundaries are specified
a bounded artifact-only materialization route is selected or branch is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2367 designs target consolidation and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2367; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU comparison verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2365 localization artifacts and M2366 audit.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Consolidated weak-outcome targets should be explicit design inputs, not interpreted as driver ranking or self-ID evidence.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: prepares a consolidated target/guardrail panel from a measured outcome localization panel
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit artifact materialization for repair targets but cannot establish paper verdict
must_synthesize_if: M2367 cannot specify non-overlapping target and guardrail categories
M2367 proposes direct profile ranking or paper conclusion
the outcome-localization branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: A bounded consolidation design can convert the overlapping M2365 localization slices into actionable target, collision guardrail, R4 mitigation, and diagnostic-only categories without rerun or ranking claims.
success_criteria: actionable target axes and diagnostic-only axes are specified
collision guardrail and R4 mitigation semantics boundaries are preserved
ranking, winner selection, paper-level, finite-window-vs-GRU, and level3 self-ID claims remain blocked
a bounded artifact-only materializer route is selected or branch is stopped
failure_criteria: M2367 reruns reset rollout measured execution replay PPO or private holdout
M2367 ranks support policies or controller families
M2367 makes paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 self-ID claims
M2367 claims scenario redesign executed or training repair success
M2367 cannot separate actionable targets from diagnostic profile/pack/global axes

commands.name: design
commands.command: manual design from M2366 audit and M2365 localization artifacts

decision_rule: M2367 passes if it defines a bounded non-ranking consolidation design and selects an artifact-only materialization route or stops the branch.
